list.title: Inference Services
list.description: The models swiss deployed, each serving an OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Deploy from the model library; upgrade, roll back and uninstall on each service.

disabled.readOnly: This swissd is read-only: turn on both server.allowDeploy and rbac.allowDeploy
disabled.untracked: A release with no plan beside it cannot be upgraded here
disabled.current: This is already the current revision
disabled.sloOff: SLO was not turned on at deploy; turn it on in an upgrade
disabled.sloPending: SLO shows once the deploy has applied

uninstall.title: Uninstall inference service
uninstall.description: Runs helm uninstall: the model stops serving, its pods are deleted, and the plan beside the release is removed (the audit log keeps the record). Installing it again reloads the weights, which takes 20–40 minutes.
uninstall.planError: The release is gone, but its plan ConfigMap was not removed: {error}

detail.untracked: Untracked: there is no plan beside this release
detail.notFound: No helm release here. Nothing has been installed under this name.

overview.noStore: This swissd has no database, so the activity log is empty
overview.applyingHint: An apply was started and never recorded a result. It may still be running, or swissd may have been restarted mid-apply.
overview.coldLoad: A cold load takes 20–40 minutes. A pod that is scheduled and not ready has most likely been reading weights, not failing.
overview.stalled: A pod has not been ready for over an hour, well past a normal load. Check the instances.

versions.title: Revision history
versions.hint: A rollback shows its diff first and runs once confirmed.

slo.title: SLO of {release}
slo.description: What the scaler sizes the service by: the latency and throughput to hold, and the replica bounds.

plan.title: Plan
plan.description: What this release was composed from, read from the ConfigMap beside it.

catalog.title: Model Library
catalog.description: The models a catalog can deploy. Open a card for its variants and where they fit, and deploy from a variant.
catalog.empty: No models in this catalog yet
catalog.noCatalogAction: Add one in the site profile
catalog.choose: Several catalogs are configured. Pick one:

deploy.title: Deploy an inference service
deploy.description: Pick a model and variant, compose the plan, review what changes, then confirm.
deploy.descriptionUpgrade: Change the target or settings, compose a new plan, review what changes, then confirm.

fields.serviceIdHint: Names the helm release, the route, the scaler and the SLO
fields.serviceIdLocked: Fixed on an upgrade: the route, the scaler and the SLO are named after it
fields.namespaceLocked: Fixed on an upgrade: another namespace installs a second release
fields.createNamespaceHint: Helm creates it during install (helmDefaults.createNamespace in the plan)
fields.scalerHint: On by default: an LLMScaler owns the replica count between min and max; empty keeps the chart's bounds
fields.gpuProductsHint: Restricts scheduling to these products, any one will do; none means any the variant supports
fields.gpuProductsEmpty: No GPU product reported by this cluster
fields.tolerationsHint: Lets this deploy land on tainted GPU nodes
fields.localPathHint: Overrides the site profile's path template
fields.imageHint: Off uses the catalog's tag and the site's mirror
fields.modelRouteHint: Publishes a ModelRoute to openresty and the monitor
fields.exposeRoutedPeerHint: Echoes the chosen backend as X-Routed-Peer; on by default in the chart
fields.backendMaxConcurrencyHint: Per-backend max concurrency; empty keeps the chart default
fields.extrasHint: openresty's own tuning knobs, sent verbatim. Each says what happens without it; leaving one out is usually right
fields.extrasFull: {max} values is the CRD's cap for one route
fields.extrasCustomHint: Any key openresty's route table reads, sent untouched
fields.idle: Needs adaptive concurrency to do anything
fields.sloHint: Primary: an LLMSLORequirement declares ttft_metrics / tps_metrics for openresty, ahead of static limits
fields.ttftHint: With SLO on, used only when no ttft_metrics is declared; empty omits
fields.tpsHint: With SLO on, used only when no tps_metrics is declared; empty omits
fields.adaptiveCcHint: AIMD on the effective TPS signal; on by default
fields.adaptiveCcMinFracHint: Of the static peer max, 0 < value ≤ 1; empty leaves openresty's 0.4. Unused when the absolute floor is set
fields.fracRange: Must be over 0 and at most 1, or openresty ignores it
fields.monitorHint: Writes the backends into monitor's config
fields.monitorModelHint: served-model-name on monitor rows; empty uses the chart default
fields.monitorGpuTypeHint: Empty lets autoconfig derive it from the node's GPU label
fields.serviceMonitorHint: Prometheus metrics scraped alongside the release
fields.editsHint: Any values key, applied after every layer and exempt from layer ownership; shown as its own edit layer in the plan

errors.format: Lowercase letters, digits and -, starting with a letter and ending with a letter or digit (it names Kubernetes Services, so no dots)

review.title: Review
review.identical: Identical to what is deployed; nothing to do.
review.noteHint: Why this is done; kept with the run and beside the release
review.forceHint: Takes over fields helm sees owned by someone else, for this apply only
review.readOnly: This swissd is read-only: turn on config.allowDeploy

rollbackSheet.title: Roll back {release} to revision {revision}
rollbackSheet.description: Re-applies that revision's plan exactly as it ran; to change settings, upgrade instead.

runsPage.title: Activity
runsPage.description: Every deploy, upgrade, rollback and uninstall swissd ran on an inference service. Expand a row for its full output.

nodes.title: Nodes
nodes.description: The cluster's nodes and GPU inventory: which products have room, the largest deploy that fits, and which nodes are unavailable.
nodes.usageError: GPU usage could not be measured (the cluster-wide pod list was refused): {error}
nodes.search: Search nodes, IPs, taints or pods

detail.noPods: No pod holds a GPU here

profile.title: Site Profile
profile.description: How this cluster deploys: where models come from, where charts and images are pulled, and what routing and scaling connect to. Deploy forms do not retype any of it.
profile.editDescription: The server parses before it stores; a profile that does not parse is not written.
profile.parseError: The site profile does not parse: {error}

hints.placement: Where releases land. The scheduler and priority class apply before the deploy form merges, so a deploy can override either.
hints.catalog: Where the models come from, and the registries the catalog deliberately does not name.
hints.model: Built from the catalog's source.hf. Variables: hf (the full repo id), org and name (its halves), model (the catalog entry name); see the field's example for the syntax.
hints.routing: The openresty entrypoint every model publishes a route on.
hints.auth: Used only by the serving and health checks. This document is a ConfigMap, so it names a Secret rather than holding the key.
hints.sites: The swissd instances in other clusters, for the switcher in the header. A list you keep.

fields.name: Cluster name
fields.nameHint: Recorded against every plan composed here
fields.gpusPerNodeHint: A full GPU node, used to derive cache.maxSlotsPerNode
fields.catalogsHint: Each an https base or an absolute path, under a name. With several, pages open in the default one. Set here they win over swissd's config file
fields.chartRepoHint: An https helm repo or oci:// registry, e.g. https://modelsphere.github.io/helm-charts; empty means a local chart path
fields.chartPathHint: Unused when a repo is set
fields.mirrorHint: Replaces the host/org of an engine image. The catalog pins the build; this says where it is pulled from
fields.overridesHint: Keyed by catalog model name, for weights that do not sit where the template says
fields.gatewayHint: Where callers reach openresty from outside. Display only: a model's URL shows as gateway/route, checks still call the service in-cluster
fields.nginxConfigMapHint: ns/name: the shared document every model writes a key into; route collisions are checked within it
fields.nginxServiceHint: ns/name, called by the serving and health checks
fields.secretRefHint: ns/name, or a bare name for a Secret in swissd's namespace
fields.prefixHint: What precedes the key. Empty on a custom header is meaningful: X-Api-Key carries no scheme
fields.headersHint: Sent on every call to the entrypoint; not a place for credentials
fields.cacheHint: Off emits nothing under cache: not every chart version has the section, and a values file with an unknown key is rejected
fields.serverAddressHint: What the chart receives: the decision server, or the Prometheus query API, depending on the provider a deploy picks
fields.sloAddressHint: Same service. swissd reads and edits LLMSLORequirement thresholds through it after install; not copied into chart values
fields.sloTokenSecretHint: The Secret holding the bearer token (ns/name, or a bare name in swissd's namespace); the token is not stored here
fields.sloTokenKeyHint: Key inside that Secret; defaults to token

setup.title: Set up this site
setup.description: This swissd has no site profile yet. Describe the cluster first: the model catalog, the chart repo, the model paths. Deploying starts once it is saved.

events.title: Events
events.retention: Kubernetes keeps events for an hour by default

logs.title: Logs
logs.previousHint: After a restart, the log of the run before it
logs.noPods: No pods yet, so no logs
logs.truncated: Showing the last {n} lines, at most 2 MiB
